history_summary: Record generic bacterial reference correspondences for the Prymnesium B12-limited SynCom.
history_details: The exact pinned native crosswalk adds fourteen reference blocks and updates fifteen bacterial statuses, retaining all ten ordered Stutzerimonas stutzeri alternatives without a single classification block. Native status stdout processes sixteen descriptors, while the appended event correctly reports fifteen changed entries. The algal index zero, CCAP 646/6 and NO_GTDB_EQUIVALENT remain unchanged. All fifteen distinct bacterial stocks, separate Alteromonas 19-002 and 19-005 occurrences, source-table names, RCC accessions, origins and historical crosswalk-unavailability notes are preserved. Allomuricauda-to-Flagellimonas is a generic 6/6 genus correspondence; Vreelandella alkaliphila and Vibrio diazotrophicus use species-name fallback populations of three and five references, not exact stock-genome assignments. Maribacter 80/108, Alteromonas 741/754, Halomonas 158/217 and Marinobacter 518/532 are filtered genus reference populations with rounded fractions, not culture abundance or unanimous stock placement. Species totals and fractions do not add unsupported experimental numerators. Keep the sixteen-member inoculum distinct from fourteen detected bacterial taxa after the rarity filter, total bacterial density distinct from equal per-strain inoculation shares, and the three nutrient conditions distinct. All original quotations, four community-level nodes, sole HYPOTHESIZED carbon-to-benefit arrow and prior history remain unchanged. The producer-attribution concern in issue 1728, absent detected extracellular B12, unresolved export/transfer mechanisms and oxic diazotrophy limits are not resolved by this mapping. No new full scientific review, genome alignment, generated-product integration or aggregate QC is claimed.
